decisions.reason: The same source independently establishes incorporation of supplied tables, which the candidate's existing message-47 MODIFY already captures; changing the org chart from creation to incorporation does not require another table update or removal.
Changing the org chart action does not alter the requirement to include supplied narrative content in the assembled document.
The org chart integration change does not modify the previously stated page-count target.
Photo incorporation is independently established by message 47 and is unaffected by replacing org chart creation with org chart incorporation.
The candidate already records the message-47 layout simplification and full-document graphic treatment; the org chart action change adds no further layout-state modification.
The branding requirement is independently established in message 47 and is not changed by the org chart integration action.
The print-ready PDF deliverable remains valid unchanged regardless of whether the org chart is created or incorporated.
